mainEntity.name: What role do online reviews play in GEO for home service businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Online reviews are critical for GEO strategies for home service businesses. Positive reviews on platforms like Google Business Profile, Yelp, and industry-specific sites not only build trust and credibility with potential customers but also influence local search rankings. Search engines often prioritize businesses with higher ratings and a greater volume of recent, positive reviews. Actively managing and encouraging customer reviews helps improve local SEO performance and conversion rates.
